notes.title: The update is being carried over
notes.notes:
The update is being carried over. I'm busy with other things right now. And did not have time to complete the update.

In the [url=https://discord.gg/QDTbxbk]Discord [/url], you can find out more news about the game and get access to closed updates.

notes.title: Update - Alpha 2.21
notes.notes:
- improved save system
- added the ability to load the game from the main menu

notes.title: Next update
notes.notes:
Hello. 
The next global update for the game will be released on April 19.
I have seen that a lot of reviews are related to the save system, I will try to fix the errors for the next update, or perhaps a patch will be released soon to fix the saves.
In the next update:
- improved save system
- improved optimization
- fix the animation
- adding a first-person view
- adding new locations on the map
- adding a change of control keys
- adding a character change
- the ability to tame dogs
- the ability to tame deer and move with their help
You can also offer your ideas, game concepts in our community [url=https://discord.gg/QDTbxbk]Discord[/url]
